root_text:
Stay Safe from HMPV!
Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) spreads like the flu, causing cough, fever, and breathing issues. Protect yourself and loved ones:
🧼 Wash hands often
😷 Wear masks in crowded areas
🤧 Cover coughs and sneezes
💉 Consult a doc
